cards.Right now: What it is doing, read live every few seconds.
cards.Visit: Talk with it in a hosted visit: the conversation becomes its memories, and closing the visit runs its reflection. A visit pauses its personal time until you close it.
cards.Emergency freeze: Kills its personal-time process now and stops it: work in progress ends without reflection. For hard failures only; turn Active on in its Accounts row to bring it back.
cards.Mind: The model it thinks with. Changes save by themselves.
cards.Voice: How it sounds when it speaks. Changes save by themselves.
cards.Work order: A task it works on instead of its personal time, from its next day on, with the Work tools below. It says itself when the task is done or blocked.
cards.Tools per phase: Which tools it may use in each phase of its day. Each box saves when you tick it.
cards.Instructions: Layers you may rewrite in its system prompt; an empty layer uses the built-in text. Its identity is never editable. Each layer saves when you leave it.
cards.Identity: Verify memory checks that its memory history and birth record were never altered. It only reads.
cards.Awake or asleep: On: it serves visits and work. Off: it sleeps, its memory consolidates, and the next visit wakes it.
cards.Personal time: On: it explores on its own schedule and spends tokens without anyone watching. Off: it acts only when visited or given work.
cards.Memories from sleep waiting for your rev: Sleep proposes new long-term memories. Keep one with two independent records that back it up, or reject it with a reason.
cards.Danger zone: rebuild its memory index: Only when the status below says MISMATCH: re-computes every memory's search vector with the gateway's embedding model. Type that model's name to confirm you mean it.

freeze_question: Freeze it now? Its process is killed, an open visit closes without reflection, and it refuses everything until Active is turned back on.

create.title: Summon a new entity
create.lead: Pick a spark template and name it. The name is permanent — there is no delete (spark v1-for-life), so it is validated (dry-run) before anything is written.
create.admin_note: Optional configuration (substrate, per-phase capabilities) requires an admin session — entities you create carry the safe framework defaults; an admin can configure them after.
create.optional_lead: Defaults are safe: leave anything on Gateway default to inherit it.
create.create_tip: Dry-run validate the name and configuration, then create

sub.sleep_question: Put it to sleep? An open visit closes and its reflection runs first.
sub.reembed_question: Rebuild every memory vector now? The swap is atomic and recorded in its history.
sub.reason_help: Optional: recorded in its history with the next change you make on this tab, and given to it when it wakes.
sub.empty_phase_desc: On: a phase with every box cleared has no tools at all. Off: it goes back to the default tools.
sub.schedule_help: Used the next time Personal time is switched on. Blank fields keep the defaults.

templates.title: Spark templates
templates.lead: A template is a reusable blueprint — every save is a new version; the framework default is the floor and can be seeded but not edited. Editing a template never touches a living entity.

edit.label: Edit
edit.tip: Edit this template (saves as a new version)

new.tip: Create a new template seeded from the selected one

save.tip: Lint and save as a new version
